_note: document-access-exception (Ruben 24 Oct, board DqDocumentenBeheer, the Who can see this card). A document may name the only people and groups who see it, with a reason. The case's handler and administrators keep access (InformatieobjectAccessGuard + DocumentAccessExceptionRule). Written only through PUT/DELETE /api/informatieobjecten/{id}/access-exception, which also restricts the file in OpenRegister and appends to accessExceptionHistory. Minor bump: two optional properties, nothing existing changes.

accessException.title: Access exception
accessException.description: Only these people and groups see this document, besides the case's handler and administrators. A reason is required. Set and removed through the document's Who can see this card.

accessExceptionHistory.title: Access exception history
accessExceptionHistory.description: Every set, change and removal of the access exception: who, when, the old and the new exception, and the reason.

old.description: The exception before, absent when there was none.

new.description: The exception after, absent when it was removed.
